stem.en: Rohan studies from 6 PM to 7:30 PM. The minute hand of the wall clock is 7 cm long. What distance does the tip of the minute hand travel in this time, in cm? Use π = 22/7.

explanation.en: In one hour the tip goes round once: 2πR = 2 x 22/7 x 7 cm = 44 cm. From 6 PM to 7:30 PM is one and a half rounds, so the distance is 1.5 x 44 cm = 66 cm. The tip starts at 12 and ends at 6, so its displacement is only the diameter, 14 cm.

hints.en: How many rounds does the minute hand make in one and a half hours?
